risk_if_not_implemented: Without Post-Quantum Cryptography (PQC) Discovery & Visibility, sensitive data with long confidentiality lifetimes remains protected only by quantum-vulnerable cryptography, exposing it to future decryption. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Unaddressed Security / Compliance Exposure (R-GV-2), and most likely increases susceptibility to Human Error (MT-9), Cryptographic Compromise / Cryptanalytic Capability Advancement (MT-31).

compensating_control_1.name: Asset Inventories
compensating_control_1.justification: Asset Inventories (AST-04) provides asset and inventory visibility that compensates for the absence of Post-Quantum Cryptography (PQC) Discovery & Visibility (QTS-07) by providing the foundational asset knowledge needed to manage risks associated with the primary control. Given the technology-focused nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Vulnerability Scanning
compensating_control_2.description: Mechanisms exist to detect vulnerabilities and configuration errors by routine vulnerability scanning of systems and applications.
compensating_control_2.justification: Vulnerability Scanning (VPM-12) provides vulnerability management that compensates for the absence of Post-Quantum Cryptography (PQC) Discovery & Visibility (QTS-07) by reducing the exploitable attack surface by addressing known weaknesses and prioritizing critical remediations. Given the technology-focused nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
